template: trade_when(greater(abs(group_zscore(quantile(vector_neut(winsorize(ts_backfill({fundreportedequityassets},63),std=4), winsorize(ts_backfill({reported_asset_value},63),std=4)), driver="gaussian"), industry)), add(1.5, multiply(0.5, ts_mean(ts_std_dev(group_zscore(vector_neut(winsorize(ts_backfill({fundreportedequityassets},63),std=4), winsorize(ts_backfill({reported_asset_value},63),std=4)), industry), 20), 60)))), multiply(sign(group_zscore(quantile(vector_neut(winsorize(ts_backfill({fundreportedequityassets},63),std=4), winsorize(ts_backfill({reported_asset_value},63),std=4)), driver="gaussian"), industry)), abs(group_zscore(quantile(vector_neut(winsorize(ts_backfill({fundreportedequityassets},63),std=4), winsorize(ts_backfill({reported_asset_value},63),std=4)), driver="gaussian"), industry))), 0)
idea: 使用高斯分布拉伸（quantile with gaussian driver）将极端偏离度进一步推向尾部，构建自适应阈值：基础阈值1.5加上60日滚动波动率调整项（0.5×σ）。通过trade_when仅在信号强度超越动态阈值时开仓，中间区域强制为零，实现'尾部极化+波动率自适应'的精炼信号，避免在市场动荡期阈值过低导致的过度交易。
